nodes.label: Phase 1 Slice 3 Handoff
nodes.rationale: Twelve tasks, twelve commits. Exit run showed 151 x 4 derivative rows, 15/15 rungs clean through Khronos gltf-validator, L0 86.1% smaller than L2 across the corpus, and throughput up rather than down. The honest reading of the throughput rise is machine variance: the ladder did not cost 3x, it cost nothing measurable. Not proved: nothing reads a rung yet, and the corpus is 150 dense organic scenery STLs, so 86% should not be quoted as universal.

nodes.label: Reap Keyed on This Job's Bytes
nodes.rationale: The plan put the derivative reap on the record error arm only, but link_existing writes rungs too. The larger problem is the other direction: a rung is usually bytes an earlier revision already stores, so reaping on any failed ingest deletes a part that ingested perfectly well. The reap is keyed on 'this job introduced these bytes', asked of PgBlobs::exists — the same authority the source blob asks.

nodes.label: check-strings EXEMPT List
nodes.rationale: Pinned by line number, so any edit above an exempt line shifts it and the gate goes stale. It went stale five times during one slice. Keying on a content fingerprint would end it.

nodes.label: Fixtures Too Coarse to Discriminate
nodes.rationale: Three mutations did not bite as written, all the same mistake. The 20-triangle bracket is coarser than L0's own grid, so its rungs are identical by design and no ladder mutation can change them; a collapsed cell is usually also touched by a surviving triangle, so it needed a deliberate fixture of one large triangle plus one tiny isolated one. In this repo, 'pick the standard fixture' is not a safe default for any test about cluster output.
